|extra_sections=<h2>Publication history</h2>
The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original (unnumbered)''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (and to Attack Run total if piloting lead starfighter). If piloting at a battleground during your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force or take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Numbered''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered)|Luke Skywalker (V) — Numbered]]): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (and to Attack Run total if piloting lead starfighter). If piloting at a battleground during your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force or take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Remastered (2006)''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Luke Skywalker (V) — Remastered (2006)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may take one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “pilots (and to” → “pilots. If piloting lead starfighter,”; added “is +3. During your control phase,”; removed “piloting lead starfighter). If”; “battleground during your control phase,” → “battleground,”; added “take one Darklighter Spin or”; removed “or take Darklighter Spin”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards1a.pdf] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193759/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf Internet Archive]) — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002); page 1, slip 1. Slip image and game text from this sheet.

* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Luke Skywalker]].
* Later text: [[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Luke Skywalker (V) — Remastered (2006)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).

For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Luke Skywalker]].
